clause: After one sweep, every harness doc collection (each source_key harness:<slug> with at least one harness doc) has at least one doc_sections row with a non-null embedding.
database: live operator DB (native PG :5432, database papercusp)
rerun: dev:pg_query { sql: <censusSql>, allowUnscoped: true } and dev:pg_query { sql: <perCollectionSql>, allowUnscoped: true }
censusSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT source_key) AS collections, count(*) AS sections, count(embedding) AS embedded, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT source_key FROM harness_shared.doc_sections WHERE source_key LIKE 'harness:%' GROUP BY source_key HAVING count(embedding) = 0) z) AS collections_with_no_embedded_row, now() AS at FROM harness_shared.doc_sections WHERE source_key LIKE 'harness:%'
perCollectionSql: SELECT source_key, count(*) n, count(embedding) e FROM harness_shared.doc_sections WHERE source_key LIKE 'harness:%' GROUP BY source_key ORDER BY source_key
note: [self-imposed under AUTO #970, WI-10003944] Re-measured for P-015 after the rev-8 amendment staled the 05:26Z census (binding 16376). Same result shape as 04:07Z, 04:36Z and 05:26Z; one more section than at 05:26Z (4,086 vs 4,085), also embedded.
